notes.title: Tinkr Log
notes.content:
Hey folks,

In this update, we added some AI vehicles and a simple quest for you to get familiar with the map. We are continuing working on the Physics: we've increased the top speed, brake torque, reduced inertia, gear switching time and friction. It's not optimal yet, we would like to hear from guys on how to improve it.

We want to make it an open-ended system and eventually be able to accept 2D and 3D assets from gamers. For now, you can upload your own stickers from this link blow, they will be popped up in the garage.
https://tinkrinc.com/community/stickers

UI Update:
Added Speedometer, Big Map (hold M)

Tinkr Devs

notes.title: Weapon system update
notes.content:
Hello people! We just pushed our first update to live. We have fixed a few things:

- Added mouse control for weapons. Now the direction of the weapon is in sync with the first person camera.

- Increased Steer Angle to 70 degrees (was 45), now the turning radius is smaller. 

- Slightly optimized physics and bounding boxes. If you still experience weird things, please let us know. (e.g. falling through the landscape)

- Updated SFX and music. Many people disliked the previous menu music, is it because it was loud & there was no audio settings or because of the music itself?

- Objects are dynamically spawned by the backend now. (Sorry, we were lazy and hard-coded those values in C++.)

- Added graphics options.

notes.title: We are on it!
notes.content:
Hello gamers, 

First of all, we would like to thank you all for playing Tinkr Garage. It has tons of bugs, annoying music, clumy control and many many imperfections.

We heard you and we will make it better!

Here is a list of things we are fixing in the next bulid,

- Make weapons easy to find, and fix the shooting mechanics
- Add Sound and Graphics options
- Small challenges/achievements to keep players engaged
- Physics, bounding box, collision
- Reduce network lag

Let us know if you have any suggestions, 

Thanks a million,
Tinkr Team
